description: Example STT evaluation manifest. Copy it to a local, uncommitted path and replace the examples with your own recordings. audioPath is resolved relative to this manifest file. Reference transcripts must be human-verified. Omit hypothesis to transcribe each recording through the configured STT providers; include it to re-score previously captured transcripts. Recordings, local manifests, and generated reports must never be committed or uploaded.
